title: fix(plugin-webhooks,runtime): a declared webhook the deployment can never deliver is reported at error and refused at the activation door
body:
Part of #24910 — this PR delivers the ruling's parts (b), (c) and the docs. Part (a), the `os validate` refusal, is left open as a fork for the seat: its honest home is `packages/spec`, a hard stop for this dispatch (see "Part (a): the fork" below). Merging this PR must not close the card.

Clause-②: no

## What changes

The webhook auto-enqueuer reads record events only from the realtime service. A stack with `requires: ['webhooks']` and without `'realtime'` therefore never delivers a declared webhook, while every door said yes.

- **(c) Boot report, `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`.** The plugin decides at `kernel:ready` whether the auto-enqueuer can run, from three prerequisites: the engine, realtime and messaging. When it cannot and the stack declares at least one webhook, the boot logs **one `error`** in place of the old `warn`. The line names each declared webhook and says none of them will be delivered while record writes keep succeeding. It names the missing service and the fix ("add 'realtime' to `requires`, then restart"). A stack that declares no webhook keeps the old `warn`. `autoEnqueue: false` (the host's own choice) logs nothing, as before.
- **(b) Activation door, `@objectstack/runtime`.** The declared-webhook reader (the `declaredWebhooks` service) is now bound already knowing that verdict: `dispatchUnavailable()` returns the same sentence, or `null` when the enqueuer runs. `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/webhook/NAME` asks the reader before switching ON. On a deployment that delivers no declared webhook it answers `503` with `error.code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'` and writes nothing. That is the shape the door already uses when it cannot consult a reader. A reader that cannot say whether it dispatches is refused the same way.
  - Switching OFF is still written.
  - An undeclared name is still `404`; the declaration is confirmed first.
  - The authority gates still answer first.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` §3.0 names the two tokens a declared webhook needs (`'webhooks'`, `'realtime'`) and what each one's absence looks like.

Files: `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/{webhook-outbox-plugin,declared-webhooks}.ts`, new `auto-enqueuer-disabled-report.test.ts`; `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts` and its `catalog-activation-door.test.ts`; the doc; `.changeset/24910-declared-webhook-undeliverable.md` (`patch` for both packages).

**Cross-lane:** the seat's declaration on #22648, comment 6295927555, named `capability-preflight.ts` (with its `validate` / `serve` call sites) and `catalog-activation.ts`. This PR touches only `catalog-activation.ts` and its test. `capability-preflight.ts`, `validate.ts` and `serve.ts` are untouched, because of the fork below.

## Premises, measured on `origin/main` `71696121a6`

- **P1 holds.** The `AutoEnqueuer`'s only event source is `IRealtimeService.subscribe` (`auto-enqueuer.ts` `start()`: three subscriptions, nothing else). `webhook-outbox-plugin.ts`'s old gate disabled it without engine, realtime or messaging. `messaging` IS on the always-on slate (`PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`), which is why the card's step 6 read `hasMessaging: true`. Under `--preset minimal` it is not mounted, and the plugin's `dependencies` on messaging then refuses the boot in the kernel's resolver; that path is not measured.
- **P2 holds.** `os validate` loads the stack (`config.webhooks`, `config.requires` and each `packages[]` body) without booting, and `preflightDeclaredCapabilities` already reads `requires` from both places.
- **P3, the honest home of the rule, is `packages/spec`.** See the fork.
- **H4, measured.** `autoEnqueue: false` has zero production callers in this tree, only tests: `plugin-webhooks` (3 sites) and one dogfood test. It is an option of an exported class, so this PR treats it as a supported host choice: no report, no door refusal. Its redelivery still reads the switch (`redeliver-guard.ts` `judgeDeclared`).

## Part (a): the fork (needs the seat's decision)

The rule "a stack that declares webhooks names `'webhooks'` and `'realtime'` in `requires`" belongs to a class that already exists: the **declared-capability refusals of `defineStack`** in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`. Its two members are `validateHierarchyScopeCapability` (`STACK_HIERARCHY_SCOPE_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED`) and `validateTriggerCapability` (`STACK_TRIGGER_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED`). The trigger rule states the same token-needs-token fact in spec text ("`triggers` installs the trigger INTO the automation service … ⛔ `triggers` never IMPLIES `automation`"), and its docblock calls itself "an ENFORCED capability class, exactly like the hierarchy scopes above". Every door that loads a stack runs those refusals: `os validate`, `os build`, `os serve` / `os dev`, `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack`, and cloud's runtime. So "serve reads the same rule" holds without a second call site. The ruling's hard stop says: if the honest home is `packages/spec`, report a fork. ⛔ No token is implied.

| Option | Business need (measured) | Long-term | Prevents AI mistakes | Startup scope |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **A. A third `defineStack` refusal in spec**, beside the trigger rule (domain:spec) | Covers every door, including the app's own tests through `bootStack`. Fixture triage: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/fixtures/webhook-materialization-fixture.ts` declares a webhook with no `requires` and deliberately boots without realtime. Six other files in lint and spec spell `webhooks: [` (five tests and `conversions/registry.ts`; some are a connector's retired nested key, not a stack's), to scan. | One rule in the contract and one class in one home. | The earliest loud refusal: at `defineStack`, even inside a test. | No new gate; one new ADR-0112 code. `defineStack`'s accept set narrows (`Clause-②` narrowing, `minor`). Cloud's resolver for `webhooks` is **NOT MEASURED** (the trigger rule measured cloud's `resolveCapabilityDependencies`); measure it first. |
| **B. A rule in the CLI preflight** (`capability-preflight.ts`, domain:cli) | Covers `os validate` / `os build`, and `os serve` after a new call site. Misses `bootStack`, so an app's tests stay green on the inert stack, and misses cloud's runtime. | A second home for one class: two members in spec, one in the CLI. The preflight's charter is provider resolution ("Not a registry rule: it reads `node_modules`, not the stack", `validate.ts` step 3b). | Loud at the CLI doors; silent in-process. | No spec lane, no error code. |
| C. `plugin-webhooks` declares the realtime plugin in `dependencies` | Boot-time "Missing dependency" only, invisible to `os validate`. It refuses a `webhooks` stack with no declared webhook and an `autoEnqueue: false` host, which H4 rules out. | Rejected. | | |

**Recommendation: A.** It joins the existing class in the one place every door reads, and its extra cost (one cloud measurement and one error code) is smaller than giving one class two homes. Under A and under B alike, a host that wires `WebhookOutboxPlugin` through `plugins[]` without naming the tokens is refused: the token is the declaration, as for triggers. H4 measured no production host of that shape.

## Tests (head `02d22e1eec`)

- New `auto-enqueuer-disabled-report.test.ts`. A real `LiteKernel` boot runs the plugin's real `kernel:ready`. It uses a real `ObjectQL` over a real in-memory `SqlDriver`, the webhook from `defineWebhook` through the engine's real `registerApp` decomposition, and messaging's real `MessagingService`. Only realtime is a stand-in.
  1. With no realtime: one `error` naming the webhook and the fix, no `disabled` warn, and `dispatchUnavailable()` names `'realtime'`. An insert plus an update enqueue **nothing**.
  2. CONTROL, with realtime: no error, `null`, and the same writes enqueue two deliveries (`declared:my_app_note_changed`, created then updated).
  3. With no declared webhook: the old `warn`, never the error.
  4. With `autoEnqueue: false`: nothing reported, and `null`.
- `catalog-activation-door.test.ts` adds 7 cases:
  - ON is refused 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` naming the webhook and the reader's reason, with nothing written. An empty body (the default, ON) is refused the same way.
  - CONTROL: OFF is written.
  - An undeclared name is still 404, and a walled tenant admin is still 403 first.
  - A reader without `dispatchUnavailable` gets 503 on ON and is written on OFF. A reader that throws gets 503.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: **23 files, 231 tests passed**. `typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: **435 files, 7609 passed, 19 skipped**. `typecheck` exit 0.
- **Ablation**, one leg per changed behaviour. Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, anchor x1 to x0, blob moved), and each restore was proven by blob equality with HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The subjects resolve through relative `src` imports, so no `dist` was involved.
  - Leg A: the error branch is never taken. Leg 1 goes red ("expected [] to have a length of 1").
  - Leg B: the reader is born without the gap. Legs 1 and 3 go red. The first attempt at B was a no-op: its replacement text already occurred inside the anchor, the tool refused and restored, and it was re-run with a distinct replacement.
  - Leg C: the door never asks the reader. 4 door cases go red (200 where 503 was expected).

## Local gates (head `02d22e1eec`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths. The change set is the 7 files since the merge base `71696121a6`, and the tool printed 100 commands. Each ran once, sequentially, with its exit captured before any pipe.
  - First pass: 97 exited 0, and 3 exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`): `check:skill-examples` (client SDK not built), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` (dists not built).
  - After a full `turbo run build` under the verify lock (76/76 tasks), all three re-ran and exited 0. The working tree was still clean after the build.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` answered "100 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 100 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.
- Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint` first among them) and the families only CI runs are left to this PR's checks.

## Acceptance notes

- **Authored `sys_webhook` rows on the same composition.** A stack with `'webhooks'` and without `'realtime'` delivers no authored row either. With no declared webhook that stays a `warn`, as the ruling scoped (c). Known from code reading only; it is not measured through a public door here.
- **The switch's other effect.** On a deployment without realtime, switching a declared webhook ON would also have let its earlier delivery rows be redelivered (`redeliver-guard.ts` reads the switch). The door now refuses that ON too; adding `'realtime'` is the fix.
- **`Clause-②`.** This PR copies the claim's `Clause-②: no`. The activation door's change is a REST accept-set narrowing on such a deployment (`200` to `503`). By the precedent of `.changeset/24813-adopt-orphans-readonly-package.md`, that may read `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, with a `minor` runtime bump, a BREAKING note and an ADR-0087 marker in the changeset. That is the seat's call.
- **The card's own path** (a published 18.0.0 scaffold outside the workspace) is NOT MEASURED here. The defect is reproduced in-tree by test leg 1 against its control.

> **Seat's append** (`domain:services` seat 1, `session_011TdZ8GjixNZFLz1xJD9zzK`): the dev's round-2 markdown from os-dev report `6297443354` on #24910, verbatim. The dev writes the body once and never PATCHes it. Where the sections above describe part (b), the activation door's refusal or `dispatchUnavailable()`, this append supersedes them. Parts (a) and (b) go to the maintainer on #24910.

## Round 2 (head `9e0ec86422`): the boot report and the docs only

The seat's review ruled that the activation door's `200` to `503` change is a REST accept-set narrowing, which is protocol class. That goes to the maintainer together with part (a), so this PR now carries part (c) and the docs. **The sections above that describe (b), the activation door's refusal and `dispatchUnavailable()`, no longer describe this diff.**

- **Removed:**
  - The activation door's refusal. `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts` and `catalog-activation-door.test.ts` are back to `main`'s bytes, so the PR's `packages/runtime` diff is empty.
  - The declared-webhook reader's `dispatchUnavailable()` verdict, together with its `DeclaredWebhookDispatch` interface and constructor parameter. The door was its only consumer. The boot report never read it: it builds its sentence from the wiring it resolves itself. `bootWebhookTable` and the `kernel:ready` hook are byte-identical to `main` again.
- **Kept, as built:** ONE `error` at boot when the auto-enqueuer cannot run and the stack declares webhooks. It names each declared webhook, the consequence and the fix. The old `warn` stays when no webhook is declared, and `autoEnqueue: false` stays silent. The only addition to `declared-webhooks.ts` is `readDeclaredWebhookNames()`, which the report needs to name the webhooks.
- **Docs:** `webhooks.mdx` §3.0 names `'webhooks'` + `'realtime'`. It claims no refusal by the activation door or by `os validate`; it says only that switching a declared webhook on delivers nothing while `'realtime'` is missing.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` `patch` only, `Clause-②: no`. "Unchanged" names `os validate` / `os build` and the activation door.
- **Merged `origin/main`** at `feb09db14a`; it touched only `packages/cli`, with no overlap.

**Files now:** `.changeset/24910-declared-webhook-undeliverable.md`, `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx`, `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/{auto-enqueuer-disabled-report.test,declared-webhooks,webhook-outbox-plugin}.ts`.

**Tests on `9e0ec86422`:**
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 23 files, 231 tests passed. `typecheck` exit 0.
- The four-case real-kernel pin: no realtime gives 1 error and 0 enqueued; the CONTROL with realtime gives 2 deliveries; no declared webhook gives the warn only; `autoEnqueue: false` is silent.
- Ablation leg A, re-run on this head: the error branch is never taken, and the run reads "1 failed | 3 passed" ("expected [] to have a length of 1"). The restore was proven by blob equality with HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

**Gates on `9e0ec86422`:** `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` printed 100 commands (5 files vs the merge base `feb09db14`). All 100 ran under the verify lock and exited 0, after a full `turbo run build` (76/76). `--ran` reported "100 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0. Round 1's head `02d22e1eec` finished CI with 36 success and 6 skipped out of 42 check-runs, none red.
